projects.title: Intervyou
projects.description: AI-powered interview preparation platform trusted by 3,000+ users. Built and maintained RESTful backend APIs using NestJS and TypeScript for CV analysis, ATS score optimization, and mock interview features. Integrated Google Gemini API for intelligent AI-driven interview feedback. Also contributed to the frontend with Next.js. The platform helps job seekers in Indonesia land jobs faster through structured, AI-guided preparation.

projects.title: Transpo
projects.description: Online transportation booking platform serving the Malang Raya area, connecting passengers with affordable inter-city travel. Developed full-stack features for the logistics and booking management system. Built backend services with Node.js, integrated Google Maps API for route visualization, and managed relational data using Prisma ORM and MySQL. Collaborated on the React.js frontend to deliver a seamless user booking experience.

projects.title: Simakin
projects.description: AI-powered Quran memorization platform with a personal AI coach providing real-time feedback on tajweed, makhroj, and fluency. Built with Remix for a fast, full-stack experience and deployed on Google Cloud Platform. Integrated Google Gemini API for intelligent audio and text-based feedback. Features include streak tracking to motivate consistent daily practice, helping users improve recitation quality systematically.

projects.title: Safera
projects.description: Streaming donation platform designed for Indonesian content creators, offering transparent fees, instant bank transfers, and QRIS payment support. Built RESTful backend APIs with NestJS and TypeScript, and developed frontend features with Next.js. Integrated Google Gemini API for AI-powered gambling content moderation to ensure a safe creator environment. Enables creators to monetize their content reliably and transparently.

projects.title: PT Sekawan Pitu — Company Profile & E-Commerce
projects.description: Company profile and e-commerce website for a free-range livestock farm in Sukabumi, West Java. Built with Next.js and TypeScript, the platform showcases the farm's products — fresh eggs, meat, and dairy — and supports same-day local delivery orders. Delivered a clean, mobile-responsive design using TailwindCSS to help the business establish an online presence and reach local customers effectively.

projects.title: BIPA — Indonesian Language Learning Management System
projects.description: Learning Management System for structured Indonesian language teaching targeting foreign speakers (Bahasa Indonesia bagi Penutur Asing). Built a full-stack application using Laravel for the backend and React.js with TypeScript for the frontend. Features include course management, interactive lessons, and student progress tracking. Designed with a clean UI using TailwindCSS and managed relational data with MySQL and Eloquent ORM.

projects.title: LBC Laundry Management System
projects.description: Full-stack laundry management system for a small laundry business. Built using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js), the application enables business owners to manage customer orders, track wash status, and process payments through a real-time dashboard. Delivered a clean and intuitive interface with TailwindCSS, improving operational efficiency and reducing manual record-keeping for the business.

projects.title: Kasirku — Point of Sale App
projects.description: Point-of-sale and cashier management web application built for small businesses. Features include product catalog management, transaction processing, customer records, and sales reporting with visual analytics. Developed with React.js on the frontend and Laravel with MySQL on the backend. Helps small shop owners manage daily sales digitally, replacing manual cashier logs and enabling better financial tracking.

projects.title: Book Worm — Online Bookstore
projects.description: Full-stack online bookstore application built with Next.js and MySQL. Features include user authentication, book catalog with search and filtering, a shopping cart, order management, and an admin panel for inventory control. Built as a portfolio project to practice end-to-end web application development — from database design and API development to a responsive frontend interface using TailwindCSS.

projects.title: SiJawi — Javanese Cultural Education Platform
projects.description: Frontend web application for a Javanese cultural education platform, built with React.js and TypeScript using Vite. The platform features interactive lessons and quizzes designed to teach users about Javanese language, culture, and traditions. Styled with TailwindCSS for a responsive and accessible interface. Developed as part of a competition or academic project focused on preserving local Indonesian culture through technology.

projects.title: MERN Online Shop
projects.description: Full-featured e-commerce platform built with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) as a portfolio project. Includes product listing and management, user authentication, shopping cart functionality, order tracking, and payment integration. Demonstrates proficiency in building complete full-stack applications from database design through REST API development to a React.js frontend.
